description: Flattens a preset's inherits chain into the complete settings and records which level each value comes from. A BambuStudio leaf preset usually declares only a few dozen keys and inherits everything else from its parents, so to know the real value of any parameter you must look at the flattened result, not the leaf preset file. Use this whenever you need an actual setting value. No side effects.

keys.description: Return only these parameters. Omit to return all of them (a process preset has about 200 keys).

name: bambu_resolve_preset

inheritanceChain.description: The inheritance chain, from the leaf preset to the root.

provenance.description: Which level of the inheritance chain each key actually comes from. Machine G-code may come from that level's template entry, named like "<preset> template machine_start_gcode".

title: Flatten a preset inheritance chain
